skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Gains 50% Lifesteal for 1 round, then attacks a single target, dealing 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Gains 50% Lifesteal for 2 rounds, then attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 150% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] on the main target for 1 round. [Stun]: Prevents the affected unit from acting. At most 4 characters can be affected by [Stun] at the same time. After attacking, grants all Monster allies [Rage] for their next action. [Rage]: Increases ATK by 20% during the next direct action.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Grants all Monster allies 50% Lifesteal for 2 rounds, then attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 200% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] on the main target for 1 round. [Stun]: Prevents the affected unit from acting. At most 4 characters can be affected by [Stun] at the same time. After attacking, grants all Monster allies [Rage] for their next action. [Rage]: Increases ATK by 30% during the next direct action.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: During the first 2 rounds, increases the ATK of all Esper allies by 25% and reduces the ATK of all enemies by 25%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: During the first 2 rounds, increases the ATK of all Esper allies by 30% and reduces the ATK of all enemies by 30%. Additionally, Monster allies take 40% less DMG from [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] for 2 rounds.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: During the first 3 rounds, increases the ATK of all Esper allies by 30% and reduces the ATK of all enemies by 30%. Additionally, Monster allies take 40% less DMG from [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] for 3 rounds.
